_note: Declarative seed for nimbuscms.dev. Applied over MCP by seed/seed.php (idempotent). Entry field values live under `fields` (mirrors the create_/update_ tool contract). Each `slug` is honored as given (normalized + made unique by core; nimbus #174) — set it independently of the title. Body fields are 'textarea' in this scaffold; they switch to the Markdown plugin's 'markdown' type in the theme slice, when that plugin ships in the site image.

fields.tagline: A CMS an agent can run — and a human can read.
fields.subhead: Lightweight PHP. A measured 100/100 Lighthouse on the starter theme. A read+write API and an MCP control surface built on the same audited services as the admin.
fields.body: NimbusCMS is a small, standalone content management system. It renders fast server-side HTML, exposes a scoped read+write API, and lets an agent operate it over the Model Context Protocol — the same rules, one backend.
Install NimbusCMS with Docker or a PHP 8.2+ environment, copy the example environment file, and run the installer to create the schema and your first administrator.
Define a collection (a content type), add fields, and create entries — in the admin, over the API, or by asking an agent through MCP.

fields.summary: The MCP control surface and the built-in agent guide.
fields.body: Point any MCP client at Nimbus with a scoped token. The server ships its own operating guide (initialize instructions + nimbus://guide/core), so an agent knows how to define content types, write content, and manage the site — bounded by the token's scopes.

fields.summary: What NimbusCMS is, and what it is not.
fields.body: NimbusCMS is an opinionated-about-architecture, unopinionated-about-what-you-build CMS. It is deliberately small: a stable core, explicit reusable capabilities, optional plugins, and application-owned business logic.
